propositions: When JIRA_PAT environment variable is absent, the adapter constructs an anonymous client instead of failing with an error naming the variable, violating the documented security guarantee.
An empty or missing PAT is silently passed as an empty string to the Jira client constructor, which accepts it and makes anonymous requests that are misattributed as project-not-found errors.

Settings resolution at os.environ.get(JIRA_PAT, empty-string) lacks validation; the guard must be placed in build_client_from_settings to avoid breaking Python 3.11 Protocol conformance checks via hasattr on properties.
The error must be raised before any network call and must explicitly name JIRA_PAT as an environment-only variable to prevent operators from searching config files or project keys.
Whitespace-only or config-file-only PAT values must be rejected the same way to preserve the env-only contract and prevent accidental false-positive anonymous passes on permissive instances.
